onboarding.title: Welcome to MOMENTO!
onboarding.description: Capture, create, and share your special moments. Connect with friends, express yourself, and keep all your favorite memories in one beautiful place.

onboarding.title: Your Own Photo Booth
onboarding.description: Turn every moment into a fun photoshoot! Take pictures using different photo booth frames, layouts, and cute designs. Make every photo special and unique.

onboarding.title: Create Your Scrapbook Wall
onboarding.description: Make your profile more personal with your very own creative wall. Add photos, stickers, notes, decorations, and arrange everything just the way you like.

onboarding.title: Edit Your Photos Your Way
onboarding.description: Bring your creativity to life with easy-to-use editing tools. Apply filters, adjust colors, add text, use stickers, crop photos, and create beautiful memories.

onboarding.title: Connect, Post & Share
onboarding.description: Share your photos, scrapbook walls, and creative moments with the community. Discover other people's creations, interact with friends, and inspire each other.
